title: The Beatles’ White Album 50th anniversary box set to include remixes, demos and outtakes | 2018
content:
Pages: 1 2

The Beatles are to reissue the White Album on 9 November 2018, with various new mixes and bonus tracks across a range of formats, including a super deluxe box set, triple CD set, and two vinyl editions.

The album, which is officially titled The Beatles, was originally released on 22 November 1968.

The box set will contain six CDs and an audio Blu-ray disc, a 164-page book, plus reproductions of the poster and portraits of the Beatles which came with the original release.

The first two discs will contain a new remix of the White Album by Giles Martin, son of Beatles producer George Martin.

The third disc will contain demos recorded in 1968 at Kinfauns, George Harrison’s bungalow in Esher, Surrey. These mainly acoustic recordings have been newly mixed from the original four-track tapes.

CDs four, five and six will contain 50 additional studio outtakes, mostly previously-unreleased, from the White Album sessions, mixed from the four-track and eight-track tapes and presented chronologically.

The outtakes will include rehearsals and versions of ‘Hey Jude’, Revolution, ‘The Inner Light’, ‘Across The Universe’, ‘Lady Madonna’, and various non-album jams and improvisations, and a hitherto undocumented 1968 recording of the song ‘Let It Be’.

It will also include take two of ‘Helter Skelter’, recorded on 18 July 1968, an edited version of which was included on Anthology 3. This will be a slightly longer edit, lasting for nine minutes, edited down from the full twelve. Sadly, take three of the song, which lasted 27:11 – the longest song ever recorded by The Beatles – will not be included.

The Blu-ray disc will contain the 2018 stereo remix of the album in high-resolution PCM stereo; a 2018 DTS-HD master audio 5.1 surround sound mix; a 2018 Dolby True HD 5.1 surround sound album mix; and a 2018 direct transfer of the original 1968 mono mix.

The box set’s book will contain an introduction by Paul McCartney, a track-by-track breakdown of the songs, plus photos, some previously unseen, from the recording sessions, the Mad Day Out, session tape boxes and more.

There will also be two vinyl editions and a triple CD version. One vinyl version will be a double-disc set of the album’s 2018 remix, while the other will be a four-disc set which will also contain the 27 Esher demos. The vinyl editions will be released on 23 November 2018.

The triple CD set will contain the 2018 stereo remix across two discs, and the Esher demos on the third.
